name: Cosmos Food Co Inc
old_description: Cosmos Food Co., Inc., has been the leader in serving North America authentic Korean foods for 50 years since 1971. By combining our knowledge of what goes into making a great tasting kimchi from our family recipes tracing back to Korea and our know-how in manufacturing to the highest quality and safety standards, we offer North America the first one-stop-shop for authentic kimchi.
about:
Cosmos Food Co., Inc. was founded in 1971 in City of Industry, California. The company traces its roots to family recipes brought from Korea, establishing a business centered on authentic kimchi production. No founders are named in the source material.

The company manufactures a range of kimchi varieties — hot, mild, and MSG‑free — using lacto‑fermentation. It positions itself as a one‑stop shop for authentic Korean kimchi in North America, emphasizing manufacturing to high quality and safety standards. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Cosmos Food serves customers across North America, supplying authentic Korean foods to the food manufacturing and distribution sectors. The company does not name specific clients or industries beyond the broader North American market for Korean food products.

The business was built on combining generations‑old family recipes with modern manufacturing know‑how to create what it calls the first one‑stop shop for authentic kimchi in North America. Its differentiation rests on recipe authenticity and adherence to quality and safety standards.
